answer: The ledger sorts voting seats into islands by who signed whom, and a seat's lineage is every seat its signers descend from. The n-th seat whose lineage traces to one jetty votes only after n jetties, each on a different island, countersign it and lock 20 pearl apiece, forfeited if it is proven a clone. An honest newcomer needs one countersigner. An operator growing 20 clones from his jetty needs 210 countersignatures across 20 unrelated islands, and must pay each signer more than the 20 pearl it risks, over 4,200 pearl.
